label: Quotient Social — post editor
description: The Quotient social post editor (built from actual screenshots): white toolbar with the platform badge (X black tile or LinkedIn blue) + post title, kebab/share buttons, the orange flag campaign-tag pill with progress ring, 'Go to thread ↗', and the BLACK Schedule split-button with a Publish Now / Schedule for later dropdown (published posts show 'View ↗' instead); below it the dotted-grid canvas with the post card -- GREEN '✓ Post published on {date}' bar (or gray '✎ Draft') with the char counter ('652/25,000'), the author row (X: brand avatar + X corner badge + blue verified check + @handle; LinkedIn: photo + in corner badge + in name badge), the body text, up to two side-by-side media cards (image, gradient headline placeholder, or file stack), the muted Likes/Comments/Reposts/Forwards engagement row, and the footer AUTHOR block (avatar + name + platform badge + gray Author chip + the first comment, e.g. 'Apply here: {url}'). SCRIPTED performable surface. Camera anchors: post, status, media, toolbar.

platform.label: 'x' or 'linkedin' (default linkedin) -- switches badges, author treatment, and char limit default

status.label: Post status (default draft). Published shows the green bar + View button; draft shows the gray ✎ bar + black Schedule button.

published_date.label: Date in the published/scheduled bar (e.g. 'Jul 9, 2026 at 10:01 AM')

author_name.label: Author display name (default: 'Quotient AI' on X, 'Marc Ferrentino' on LinkedIn)

author_handle.label: X handle under the name (default '@Quotient_AI_' on X; hidden on LinkedIn)

author_avatar_url.label: Avatar image URL (default: Quotient logo via logo.dev on X, photo on LinkedIn)

author_initials.label: Fallback initials if the avatar image fails

verified.label: Blue verified check beside the name (default true on X)

char_limit.label: Char counter denominator (default 25000 on X, 3000 on LinkedIn)

media.label: Up to 2 side-by-side media cards: [{image_url} | {headline, subtext?} (gradient placeholder) | {kind: 'files', files: ['PDF','DOC'], label}]

tag_progress.label: Tag progress fraction shown in the pill + ring (default '0/1')

show_app_bar.label: Show the app chrome bar above the toolbar (bell, Search ⌘+K, New Chat)

script.label: Actions: scroll-post {amount, duration}, highlight-status, highlight-media, open-schedule-menu (the black button's Publish Now / Schedule for later dropdown drops down), close-schedule-menu, publish-post {published_date?} (Publish Now row flashes, menu closes, the bar flips GREEN '✓ Post published on …' and Schedule becomes View -- THE money beat), schedule-post {scheduled_date}. Plus base actions (move-cursor, click, wait). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (post, status, media, toolbar).

author_comment.label: Footer author block: the author's first comment under the post (e.g. 'Apply here: https://...') -- shows the avatar + name + platform badge + gray Author chip. Legacy author_url maps here.

show_engagement.label: Muted Likes / Comments / Reposts / Forwards row under the post (default true)

script_actions.description: Smoothly scroll the post card content down
Pulse a glow on the status bar
Press the black Schedule button; the Publish Now / Schedule for later dropdown opens beneath it
The publish beat: the Publish Now row flashes, the menu closes, the status bar flips to the green '✓ Post published on {date}' treatment and the Schedule button becomes View ↗

params.published_date: string - date text for the green bar

script_actions.description: Flip the status bar to the blue 'Scheduled for {date}' treatment
